sweeping_method: gunfire destruction of mines located visually or cut by minesweepers
result: PC-584 and other patrol craft were firing on mines; Halligan probably struck the same mine line
position_basis: Localized near 26.158333 N, 127.508333 E from two approximate contemporary reports
source_locator: PC-584 Action Report Serial 0063, report pp.1 and 4-6 (compiled PDF pp.113-119)
notes: Accepted as documented mine-destruction activity in Area B-5. No count is assigned to 26 March because the report does not give a defensible same-day total. PC-584 later reported five specifically described mines sunk on 27 March and seven over the broader pre-assault period. No safe or cleared status is inferred.
